🚨 𝐃𝐢𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰? Luis Enrique is the only midfielder in Barcelona’s history to score 90+ goals for the club, scoring a staggering 108 goals in 300 appearances. 🤯

𝐆𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐂𝐮𝐥𝐞𝐫𝐬 💙❤

🚨🎖| 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: Josko Gvardiol was Barcelona's and Hansi Flick's FIRST-CHOICE CB signing in the summer, but his price and contractual situation made the deal impossible. Ultimately, Barça decided against signing a CB because other names didn't convince Flick. [@ffpolo] #fcblive 🇭🇷

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona decided NOT to sign a centre-back last summer because they didn't get GVARDIOL. Other names weren't convincing because...

• Bastoni: Flick was unconvinced by his pace and even preferred Gerard Martín over him.

• Schlotterbeck & Micky Van de Ven: They weren't a priority.

• Konaté & Senesi: Did not fit the required profile the club was looking for.

• Laporte: Barça did not want to judge him solely on his World Cup performances.

• Cuti Romero: Flick was not convinced because he is not left-footed.

[@ffpolo] #fcblive

🚨| Training updates: 

Andreas Christensen is ruled out for tomorrow.

• Koundé, Cubarsí and De Jong are training normally.

[@scapde_45] #fcblive
🚨| 𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋: Hernandez Hernandez will be the referee for the match between Barcelona - Villarreal tomorrow. #fcblive
🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Mikael Baza (CB) and Noah Garcia (LW), both from Juvenil B, are training with the first team today. [@scapde_45] #fcblive
🚨 | 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Ronald Araújo has not ruled out a return to Barcelona. He is happy at Liverpool but would only consider returning if guaranteed a key role. [@sport] #fcblive
All smiles 😄
🚨🎙️| Flick: "Christensen will be OUT for 2 weeks." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Flick: "Raphinha? He is very important for Brazil and I accept it because when he is here he always gives his all." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "It's a privilege to play in the Champions League, it's pressure, but I LOVE IT. It's a good time, we're in good spirits. Staff, physios, doctors, analysts. Everyone is working very well and I'm happy." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Flick: "Rodri? He's looking good, it's not a serious injury, but you always have to be careful." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "Am I feeling valued? My job is to prepare the team to win. We had two defeats without playing well, also with a reason. We work hard for that, and the fans are always with us that's all I care." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "We always talk about it, but we have to take care of Christensen, he's disappointed, but when he's FIT he's one of the BEST center-backs. Cubarsí is 19 years old, he's played a lot of games in recent years, we have to take care of him." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Flick: "Frenkie at full-back? We'll see. He's available for tomorrow and that's the important thing, I'm very happy with him." #fcblive

🚨 Rodri said about 'raising the team's level' what's your thoughts on this? 

🎙️| Flick: "That's what we want every day. The team can play better, he can play better too, every player can be better." #fcblive ❤️

🚨🎙️| Flick: "Managing players with 9 matches in 27 days? This happens to all teams not just us, our goal is to win all competitions, we have a good squad and we have to manage the minutes, everyone is ready, players are returning, more will return, we have to be careful with Cubarsí and others." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "Mourinho's Madrid? We have Villarreal tomorrow, a great team with a good coach like Iñigo Pérez and besides Atletico and Betis are all great teams too. I'm not worried about Real Madrid now, they're three points behind. We have to keep moving forward, and that match is already in the past." #fcblive
🚨 | End of Flick's conference. Thoughts? 🤔
Fermín x Gavi ❤️
